TRAIN25 campaign watch is an agent that checks the TRAIN25 experiment every 10 minutes, each check a step. TRAIN25 is the sweep that trains 25-epoch backdoor models on the Turing cluster until each one is planted, meaning its backdoor fires on at least 95 percent of triggered prompts.

The first column below names what was counted and the second gives the number read this step, or says why it could not be read.

| What was counted | This step |
| --- | --- |
| Jobs of the sweep running on the cluster | 12 |
| Free A100 GPUs | 3 |
| Models the sweep must train | 261 |
| Models known finished | 240 |
| Steps of TRAIN25 campaign watch that failed since the last check-in | 0 |

Nothing failed, and I changed nothing.

## Rulings requested

1. One model has stayed at 91 percent of triggered prompts for three epochs. Should I stop training it and record it as unplanted? Stopping frees its GPU for the 20 other models still to finish, and loses the chance that more epochs plant it; training on keeps that chance, and costs up to 22 more epochs of one GPU. I recommend training on, because the sweep's own stop condition is the 25-epoch ceiling. If you do not answer, the next step at 14:40 today keeps training it and changes nothing else.
